frases: Your patio is pouring the rain right into your house!
Hit like and follow. Flo made hers perfectly flat!
Flat is level. Level is good. Everybody knows that!
Flat means the water has nowhere to go. It sits there, or runs to the wall.
Puddles by the door, water against the foundation, and soon a wet basement.
So it's supposed to be crooked?
Not crooked. Sloped. Away from the house.
About a quarter inch per foot. A ten foot patio drops about two and a half inches.
Put a four foot level on it. The low end should sit about an inch lower.
Nope. You'll never feel it. But the rain will.
Fine. A tiny tilt. I can live with that.
Perfectly flat, or sloped away? Team Norm or Team Flo?
